leadText: Running through Spacetime (Korean: 시공을 달리다 Sigongeul dallida) is the opening and ending theme for the Korean dub of Arceus and the Jewel of Life. It is performed by Mini.
plainText:
Running through Spacetime (Korean: 시공을 달리다 Sigongeul dallida) is the opening and ending theme for the Korean dub of Arceus and the Jewel of Life. It is performed by Mini.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind

 
 
 
 

Alright! 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
 

Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
 

 
 
 
 

Alright! 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
 

Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
 

 
 

Alright! Alright! Alright! Alright! 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
 

Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
 

 
 
 
 

Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind

Over the rough tides, it stops me
In this moment, as I run through the silver fragments of pouring rain
Not even one word needs to change
Fly up, traversing the ends of the world

Alright! 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Above the endless sky, setting the sails

Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
A little more without hesitation towards the sun

In the fierce wind that blocks me 
This moment I run with my two black pupils wide open
I don't need to have any worries
Fly up, traversing the ends of the world

Alright! 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Above the endless sky, setting the sails

Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
A little more without hesitation towards the sun

Don't ever stop
Start the miracle now

Alright! Alright! Alright! Alright! 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Close your eyes feel it in your mind 
Above the endless sky, setting the sails

Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
Trust yourself cast your fears aside 
A little more without hesitation towards the sun

Far away to the open sky 
Far away to the open sea
Far away, flying up endlessly
